Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.2: Creation: Parts of CREATION

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Creation: Parts of CREATION, part of GOD’S in PP2 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How many eyes do you to: different parts of the body have?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
